title: spawn starts a task eagerly; channel delivery is FIFO
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 18.1: spawn eagerly schedules the async action (main awaits only the channel before the task); channel messages are delivered FIFO.

notes: Channel endpoint names follow the active std (Sending/Receiving/item); see D-039.
